rounds.text: Rashi Peripherals Ltd is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at a modest P/E of 17.5x [E1] despite phenomenal top-line and bottom-line expansion. Compounded sales growth has reached 22% over 5 years, 19% over 3 years, and accelerated dramatically to 40% in the trailing twelve months [E14, E15, E16], handily beating sector medians [E65]. This exceptional momentum is mirrored in profitability, with compounded profit growth hitting 50% over the trailing twelve months [E19] and a rules-based screen scoring the stock a high-confidence 93 out of 100 on the back of 62% YoY sales growth and 69% YoY net profit growth [E56, E57, E59]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow valuation places intrinsic value at ₹1,722 per share against a market price of ₹841 [E39], offering a massive 51.2% margin of safety [E40]. Reverse DCF calculations show that the current price merely prices in a paltry 6.2% earnings growth expectation, leaving a wide gulf between actual delivery and market pricing [E41]. Profitability metrics also outpace sector benchmarks, with an ROCE of 15.84% compared to the sector's 11.93% [E10]. Conceded: cash conversion is weak at 0.40x for March 2026, indicating profits are currently far ahead of cash generation [E28].
